text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the flow of qi is definitely easier 
to read on dirt☆ My running feels amazing!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The clear spring brilliance is perfected 
here. But even so—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Wooooooh...)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(Her spirit is still faint. Even taking 
into account the grade of the race. Which 
means—)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Found it, the break in the dragon vein! 
This is it! A great river and a rushing 
torrent do not naturally intersect.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: —If that's the case...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I understand my aptitudes and my 
strength now☆ And what I need to do from 
here on out.
choice_data_list: You found your answer, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Looks like dirt really suits me best 
after all. Dirt is the number one surface 
to show the power of feng shui!
choice_data_list:
I see. Then we're going with the dirt 
route.
I see. The dirt route it is, then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's a pity about the Japan Derby, but 
that's one conclusion. In that case, 
focusing on dirt would be the right move.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"The surface with the best affinity for 
feng shui is dirt. That's why—"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Maybe I should run in the Nippon Derby!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What came out next were words that no one 
could have ever expected.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I finally realized it. The break in the 
dragon vein. That was the reason why 
things felt so off.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Just running on the dirt isn't enough. I 
have to channel the energy into it."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey explained with a bright 
smile on her face.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Isn't my dream to introduce Feng Shui to 
everyone and make them happy?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And while dirt is indeed the best for 
showing off the power of feng shui...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
However, dirt races get less attention 
than turf. If that's only during the 
Classic Triple Crown, that's fine, but...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"That will probably continue even if I get 
stronger. If people don't see it for 
themselves, they won't believe in the 
power of feng shui, right?"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"That was where the dragon vein was 
severed. Because there's no connection 
between 'showing' and 'spreading.'"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Sure, there are girls like Tarumae who 
work steadily to earn recognition, but 
there are also seniors like Falco-san who 
put their all into promotion.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
“Still, that's just their way of doing 
things. Resolving it through feng shui is 
*my* style.”

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: And then I found a really great way!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"A dirt specialist like me entering the 
Japan Derby... It's one of the biggest 
races around, so naturally it'll draw lots 
of attention."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If I put on a good run, people will notice 
me, right? And once they're interested in 
me—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"From there, we can guide it to the dirt. 
The Derby is the entrance, and the dirt is 
the 'Dragon's Lair.' In other words, the 
exit!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
This is the Bagua I envisioned! Not 
choosing between black or white, but a 
pattern weaving both principles together!
choice_data_list: I see. So you want to act as a bridge.
I see, so you're acting as a bridge...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Treat the Nippon Derby as a tributary, 
leading into the mainstream dirt division. 
It made total sense, and carried real 
conviction. It was truly—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was an intricate blueprint of the 
future that only Copano Rickey, with her 
mastery of feng shui, could have drawn.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
With this, I'm sure we can make all three 
kinds of happiness come true.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Yes! First of all—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Fans who learn about feng shui through 
dirt racing will be able to make their 
lives so much better!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Next, by going from dirt to the Derby, I 
can show younger racers an unexpected path 
and make them think, "Wow, you can do that 
too!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Lastly, there are those who are happy 
just to see me run in the Nippon Derby. 
Yes, for instance—"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Like my Trainer, you know? ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I tried thinking about it that way, but 
honestly, it's just my own selfish wish... 
or ideal, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Dirt races are still my main focus. If 
you say we should skip the Nippon Derby, 
Trainer, that's totally fine by me! Think 
it over!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Entering might be possible, but honestly, 
winning might be tough. Let's think about 
this carefully.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Aaaand next! Bringing as many fans along 
with me as possible, where I'm headed is—☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's gotta be a match against an Umamusume 
who's currently riding high on the dirt 
track, right? For example—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: —Tarumae, for example.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having recently won two consecutive local 
dirt GⅢ races, Hokko Tarumae is rapidly 
making a name for herself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If this keeps up, there's a very good 
chance he'll take center stage in the dirt 
division by year's end.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Which race do you think Tarumae 
should enter at the end of this year?
choice_data_list:
The most promising one is probably the 
Champions Cup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—The Champions Cup. One of currently only 
two central dirt GI races."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No dirt powerhouse would overlook this. 
The likelihood of them entering was at its 
highest.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Got it! Then let's make that our next 
goal.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
All right, the stage is set! Now all 
that's left is to follow the compass's 
guidance. Let's do this☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, heading toward the year-end 
Champions Cup, Copano Rickey proceeded 
along a narrow path hidden by overgrown 
vegetation.
